description:
Offline voice pitch, formant and voice-quality tracking for voice training

Simple Voice Tool for Trans is a serious voice measurement, analysis and training tracker built on the Web Audio API. Speak into your microphone and get pitch, formant and energy analysis in real time — fully offline, nothing leaves your device.

Measure

  • Real-time pitch curve with male / female / transition band coloring and live note readout
  • Three test modes: free reading, sustained vowel (auto-stop, Jitter) and glissando (voice range profile)
  • F1/F2 formants with vowel-space scatter and target zones for resonance training

Analyze

  • Voice quality: Jitter, Shimmer, HNR and CPPS, plus harmonic-spectral metrics
  • Voice gender expression reference: a VFP-style 0–100 score from median F0 + F2−F1 resonance, with masculine / neutral / feminine reference anchors
  • Shared time axis with zoom and crosshair readouts; accessible data-table views (copy as TSV)
  • Re-analyze saved recordings with updated algorithm parameters — no need to re-record
  • Import external audio through the same offline pipeline

Track

  • Trend charts (average F0, range, MPT, CPPS) and a GitHub-style practice heatmap
  • Voice-flower garden: each session becomes a flower, laid out by month to show long-term change
  • Pairwise comparison with delta tables and pitch overlay
  • Training targets with achievement rate and baseline comparison
  • Optional daily practice reminders

Privacy first

  • Records, audio and analysis stay in local storage (IndexedDB)
  • LAN sync: transfer records and audio directly between two devices on the same Wi-Fi — no server
  • Full ZIP backup & restore; optional encrypted cloud backup to your own GitHub repo / WebDAV / local folder
  • A data-transparency panel shows exactly what goes where

Optional AI — bring your own key

  • Training advice, weekly reports and a chat assistant via your own OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint
  • Only aggregate statistics are sent — never audio or raw curves; every request is inspectable in the app
  • Fully functional offline without any AI features

Everywhere

  • Installable as a PWA; shipped as an Android APK and a Windows installer
  • Keyboard shortcuts; 7 languages (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Español, Français, Literary Chinese)

License: MIT — https://github.com/theforeveriris/simple-voice-tools-for-trans
